units: Ber. 30ᵇ דאתא פ׳ דמלכא וכ׳ when a royal army came to the city (of Nehardea); Ab. Zar. 70ᵇ ההוא פ׳ וכ׳ an army came &c. (Rashi: a commander).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>רובא דאתי בהדי פ׳ וכ׳</he> the majority of those that came in that army (or with that commander) were Jews.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 33:15">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 33:1">Ib. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 32:7">XXXII, 7</cite> (not <he>פולמרכין</he>, <he>פולמורכ׳</he>).
